name: painted-place
description: Build a place in Blender and bring it into the painted blue-hour look of the series in one call, then let a blind judge say in plain words what to fix. Five things: the look (reference pictures and one page with measured bands), a judge (measures plus a blind rubric), the look stage (lights at every glowing window, sky rig, haze, AgX, a restrained paint filter), proven materials by role, and the loop build, look stage, small render, judge, one fix pass. No gate stops a picture; the picture is the test.
